answer: Picture an open meadow where every new agent must leave a verifiable, costly footprint before it can graze. Sybil swarms collapse when identity is anchored to scarce, checkable work: each agent stakes a ferrous-hard proof of useful computation that honest peers attest, and reputation accrues slowly like jade polished over seasons. Cloning yourself a thousandfold buys nothing, because trust is earned per real task, not per wallet minted for free.
